payment.description: Which payment system a receipt was settled through, plus its opaque reference in that system. Grouped because neither field means anything alone -- ref is only interpretable relative to processor.

ref.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID or equivalent. Independently verifiable via the payment processor.

An AT-URI + CID pointer to another record -- a catalog.item or catalog.product (purchase.receipt's purchasedGood, catalog.listing's item, catalog.product's items), a listing, or a license.terms (purchase.receipt's listing, licenseGrant and grantedItems entries). The AT-URI's own collection segment already identifies what kind of record this points to (at://did/{collection}/rkey), so no separate type field is stored. Supersedes #itemRef, which was identical once variants were removed.
